withdrew his offer and bequeathed the collection to the National Gallery in
London. On 3 February 1915, Lane wrote a codicil to his will restoring the
paintings to Ireland. But Lane was drowned on the Lusitania on 7 May 1915
with the codicil unwitnessed, and the English government refused to honor
